text: n sodium 0.03% is in- stilled into the eye every 30 minutes beginning 2 hours before surgery and ending not less than 30 minutes be- fore surgery. To control postoperative inflammation the same dosage regimen is used before ocular surgery followed 24 hours after surgery by the instillation of one drop 4 times daily for 1 to 3 weeks. Flurbiprofen sodium eye drops have also been used in the topical treatment of cystoid macular oedema. Flurbiprofen axetil has been given in some countries by intravenous injection for severe pain. The R-enantiomer, tarenflurbil, is under investigation in the management of Alzheimer’s disease. Preparations BP 2008: Flurbiprofen Eye Drops; Flurbiprofen Suppositories; Flurbiprofen Tablets; USP 31: Flurbiprofen Sodium Ophthalmic Solution; Flurbiprofen Tablets.
